resources.string: Device state and lasting settings. Debloating is driven from the mobile companion.
Packages are enabled and disabled from the companion app on your phone, which talks to this television over ADB. This app keeps what a phone cannot do: the settings that must be reapplied at boot.
Values applied to the television itself.
Not granted — nothing can be written
adb shell pm grant net.jolabs40.tvslim android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
Reapplies at every boot the settings the television resets on its own.
Scan this code from TV Slim Remote, on your phone. It carries only this television address.
In the companion, Television tab: Scan. The television will then ask to allow debugging — accept with the remote, ticking “Always allow”. That authorisation survives reboots.
Network ADB debugging is off. Settings → About → tap the build number seven times, then enable network debugging.
